title: Rosemary Beach "Grand Terre" 18 N Green Turtle Lane (Carriage House)
h1: Rosemary Beach "Grand Terre" 18 N Green Turtle Lane (Carriage House)
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the private beach- Access to neighborhood pools- Short walk to Rosemary Beach town square- Balconies and covered porches- 1 Vehicle garage- 2 Adult bikes- Washer and Dryer - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled within the aesthetic coastal community of Rosemary Beach, Grand Terre Carriage House is a 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 6 guests. Guests can take advantage of 4 neighborhood pools, an idyllic town square, and plenty of options for family-friendly recreation both on and off the water—including golfing, fishing, and biking. Enjoy relaxed evenings lounging on the covered balcony or the short walk to private beach access.Contemporary furnishings and a charming pastel palette accent the bright and open floor plan of this 2-story carriage home. Hardwood floors stretch throughout the living space, where guests will find a queen sleeper sofa and a 55” Smart TV. Built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds to the side offer additional sleeping accommodations. Around the corner is a well-equipped kitchen with Bosch and Whirlpool appliances. Prepare a relaxed brunch, dine at the fashionable round table for 2, or brew coffee to enjoy on the furnished balcony.Head up the classic wood staircase to discover a comfortable and sunny guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Experience delightful days of white-sand beaches and Florida fun at Grand Terre Carriage House. Parking for 1 vehicle makes it easy to visit the nearby towns of Scenic 30A, or leisurely explore the Timpoochee Trail with 2 complimentary adult bikes. Multiple private community beach accesses are nearby, and a public beach access is at the end of Winston Lane. Book this inviting home today!CARRIAGE HOUSE: (SLEEPS 6):FIRST FLOOR:Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed in Living RoomAdditional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living RoomSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuests also have access to these Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am and 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party. Unfortunately, the private pool is for the main house only.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "Grand Terre" 18 N Green Turtle Lane (Carriage House) Inlet Beach, FL Bedrooms 1 Beds 2 Sleeps 6 Full Baths 1 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the private beach - Access to neighborhood pools - Short walk to Rosemary Beach town square - Balconies and covered porches - 1 Vehicle garage - 2 Adult bikes - Washer and Dryer - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Nestled within the aesthetic coastal community of Rosemary Beach, Grand Terre Carriage House is a 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 6 guests. Guests can take advantage of 4 neighborhood pools, an idyllic town square, and plenty of options for family-friendly recreation both on and off the water—including golfing, fishing, and biking. Enjoy relaxed evenings lounging on the covered balcony or the short walk to private beach access. Contemporary furnishings and a charming pastel palette accent the bright and open floor plan of this 2-story carriage home. Hardwood floors stretch throughout the living space, where guests will find a queen sleeper sofa and a 55” Smart TV. Built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds to the side offer additional sleeping accommodations. Around the corner is a well-equipped kitchen with Bosch and Whirlpool appliances. Prepare a relaxed brunch, dine at the fashionable round table for 2, or brew coffee to enjoy on the furnished balcony. Head up the classic wood staircase to discover a comfortable and sunny guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Experience delightful days of white-sand beaches and Florida fun at Grand Terre Carriage House. Parking for 1 vehicle makes it easy to visit the nearby towns of Scenic 30A, or leisurely explore the Timpoochee Trail with 2 complimentary adult bikes. Multiple private community beach accesses are nearby, and a public beach access is at the end of Winston Lane. Book this inviting home today!
